s1_exit_partition.label: EXPLORATORY: designed after the 31B primary results were seen (2026-11-01 ~06:05 UTC); not preregistered; descriptive; nominal 95% family-clustered t intervals; no significance claims.
notes: calls = model responses used (cost.calls, accounting.model_calls); the harness ends an episode as NoAnswer when 8 responses pass without an accepted submit_answer
noanswer_with_submit_attempt counts NoAnswer episodes with >= 1 submit_answer tool call (each such call was rejected, since no submission was accepted)
format-error counts per episode are not in scores.jsonl or CELLS.jsonl (only in result.json accounting, not read here)
s1_exit_partition.verdict_noanswer_at_budget: CONFIRMED: every NoAnswer exit (3772/3772) ended at the 8th model response (the response budget)

s2_decomposition.label: EXPLORATORY: designed after the 31B primary results were seen (2026-11-01 ~06:05 UTC); not preregistered; descriptive; nominal 95% family-clustered t intervals; no significance claims.
notes: submission_rate: item mean of 1[exit == Submitted] over the available seeds -> family -> equal-weight mean over families

recovery_given_submission: item mean of site_recovered over the item's Submitted seeds only (items with no Submitted seed drop out) -> family -> mean; POST-TREATMENT CONDITIONING on submission, descriptive only
recovery-given-submission contrasts use only items where BOTH arms submitted at least once (n_items shows how many); post-treatment conditioning, descriptive only
overall_recovery = the outcome site_recovered (non-Submitted exits score 0); the P overall_recovery contrasts reproduce H1-H3
micro: k/n over episodes; at the micro level overall recovery = submission x recovery-given-submission exactly; the family-weighted values need not multiply

where every family has the same number of items and every item the same number of episodes (P, S-VC, S-EDGE, T), the family-weighted submission and overall rates equal the micro rates exactly; conditional rates (given submission) and the unbalanced S-NAT block differ
S-NAT: site_recovered of C* is a baseline there (the block's outcomes are nm_recall/nm_any); nm_any is decomposed as well

recovery_given_submission.interval_note: zero variance: degenerate interval, not evidence of equivalence

s3_seed_concordance.definition: item-condition triple = the item's three P episodes (seeds 11, 23, 47) in one condition; identical trajectory = all three share (exit_status, calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, site_recovered); identical outcome = all three share site_recovered; family-weighted: the item indicator -> family mean -> equal-weight mean

V_size_rule.rule: nearest-rank tertile cut points of |V| over the items: c1 = the ceil(N/3)-th smallest |V|, c2 = the ceil(2N/3)-th smallest; buckets |V| <= c1, c1 < |V| <= c2, |V| > c2; fixed from the item-level |V| distribution before any outcome by bucket was computed

s5_strata.label: EXPLORATORY: designed after the 31B primary results were seen (2026-11-01 ~06:05 UTC); not preregistered; descriptive; nominal 95% family-clustered t intervals; no significance claims.
notes: each level: the H1-H3 paired contrasts (site_recovered, P seeds 11/23/47) on the level's items; families with >= 1 item in the level; t interval df = F_level - 1
strata are pre-outcome item properties; the splits were chosen after the primary results were seen, so they are EXPLORATORY; no interaction test is made

design fact: the wording pair changes only the C2/C3 guidance sentence (prereg section 6; the receipts check above confirms guidance only in C2/C3 cells), so for H2 (C4a - C1) and H3 (C1 - C0) neither arm's prompt depends on the pair: the A/B split of H2/H3 is a hash partition of the items that changes no prompt

V_size.description: size of V, tertile buckets: nearest-rank tertile cut points of |V| over the items: c1 = the ceil(N/3)-th smallest |V|, c2 = the ceil(2N/3)-th smallest; buckets |V| <= c1, c1 < |V| <= c2, |V| > c2; fixed from the item-level |V| distribution before any outcome by bucket was computed

c4_hits_policy.description: frozen c4_hits reference policy recovers C* on omit_node (policies.jsonl, policy c4_hits, variant omit_node, field site_recovered): did the C4a lexical block contain a C* site

s9_precision.label: EXPLORATORY: designed after the 31B primary results were seen (2026-11-01 ~06:05 UTC); not preregistered; descriptive; nominal 95% family-clustered t intervals; no significance claims.
notes: among Submitted episodes only (precision is undefined otherwise)
precision_lower = V-sites / all submitted entries; precision_upper = (V + U + lexical) / unique valid entries (prereg section 9)
entries not in V = u_site + lexical_name_match + unresolved (category precedence V > U > lexical > unresolved; duplicates are repeated (path, line) entries, counted separately)
family_weighted precision: item mean over the item's Submitted seeds -> family -> mean
